title: Among Us
provenance: Reported by halonsoluis (highball-db#29, 2026-09-13), Apple M2 Pro, macOS 26.5, Highball 0.9.9, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 3 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXMT on the default engine, a short session. Online play is the whole game and the reporter did not say whether a lobby was joined. Measured on an M4 with macOS 27.0 on 2026-09-30, DXMT, the first menus only (age check and sign-in screen), not played. The current 64-bit build often closes by itself right after starting on the Wine 10 engines, see known issues.

knownIssues.symptom: Closes by itself within two seconds of starting, often. On an M4 with macOS 27.0 that happened in 8 of 12 launches on the Wine 10 engines (r13 and r15) and in none of 5 on the Wine 11 engine
knownIssues.cause: Not found yet. The game raises an exception on its main thread right after its audio starts, and Wine 10 cannot unwind it ("invalid frame" in the log). The reports from before the game's 64-bit build do not mention it
knownIssues.fix: Press Play again, it starts on a later try. Or set the environment's engine to the newest x64-crossover26.3 one (Settings, Environments, your environment, Advanced, Engine), where it started every time

knownIssues.symptom: After switching to another app and back, the game keeps drawing but ignores clicks and keys until it is restarted
knownIssues.cause: Wine 10's Mac driver sent the game a made-up click in its title bar whenever macOS gave it focus back, and Unity ignores the focus gain that follows such a click, so it keeps drawing but drops every click and key (Wine bug 48121, highball#182). Measured on an M4 with macOS 27.0: after Cmd+Tab the age check took no clicks on engine r13 and takes them on r15
knownIssues.fix: Fixed in engine r15, which environments on the default engine pick up by themselves once Steam is closed. On an older engine, restart the game.
